# What the bundled cmake + ninja ship — a KEEP list, read by
# dist/package-toolchain.sh.
#
# Grammar is dist/emsdk-trim.txt's: paths are relative to the staged buildtools/
# root and may glob, a directory keeps its whole subtree, a `windows: ` /
# `posix: ` prefix scopes a line to that OS's tree, comments take a whole line,
# and AN ENTRY MATCHING NOTHING IS FATAL — an upstream rename must fail here
# rather than ship a tool quietly short a data file.
#
# The oracle for an over-trim is the packaging's own per-axis configure, which
# runs the staged cmake: a module or data file this list drops dies there, not
# in a user's export log.
#
# The licence of a package that survives is kept whatever this file says, and
# copied into LICENSES/ at the root — but only where a kept file remains in the
# licence's OWN directory, which is why the ones under doc/ are named below.

# ── The executables ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# One cmake. ccmake/cpack/ctest are front-ends no export runs, and cmake-gui is
# a symlink into the macOS .app's Qt payload — 46 MiB of Frameworks/ and
# PlugIns/ behind it.
posix: cmake/bin/cmake
windows: cmake/bin/cmake.exe
# The Ninja generator's RC dependency scanner. cmake locates it in C++ beside
# cmake.exe and never through a module, so a grep over Modules/ finds nothing
# and a grep-driven trim drops it — invisible until an MSVC configure.
windows: cmake/bin/cmcldeps.exe
posix: ninja/ninja
windows: ninja/ninja.exe

# ── cmake's own module tree ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# WHOLE, and that is a decision rather than laziness: runtime/CMakeLists.txt's
# FindThreads and CheckCXXSourceCompiles, curl's FindMbedTLS / FindNGHTTP2 and
# its platform checks, Emscripten's platform module and the NDK's toolchain file
# all reach in through find_package / include(), and every try_compile reads the
# ABI and compiler-id sources under it. A list of the modules today's configure
# happens to name is a second, drifting expression of somebody else's
# CMakeLists — and this is ~5 MiB.
cmake/share/cmake-*/Modules

# Templates/ is dropped: only Modules/CPack.cmake and Modules/CTestTargets.cmake
# read it, curl's `include(CPack)` sits inside `if(NOT CURL_DISABLE_INSTALL)`
# and runtime/CMakeLists.txt forces that ON, and nothing here includes CTest.
# The per-axis configure is the oracle if either flips.

# ── Licences ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Named explicitly: everything else under doc/ is dropped, so the rule that
# keeps a licence beside its surviving package cannot reach these, and the
# bundle would ship binaries with no licence text at all. Each doc/cmake/cm*/
# holds one vendored library's licence and nothing else, so the directory is
# globbed whole — the file NAME is not one set (COPYING, LICENSE, NOTICE, and
# cmsys's Copyright.txt), and which libraries a host's archive bundles varies.
cmake/doc/cmake/LICENSE.rst
cmake/doc/cmake/cm*/*
cmake/share/cmake-*/Licenses
